resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (mguangfu.bjx.com.cn) is a 200 that does not verifiably name/support this segment (a syndicated April-2025 republish of older Baise-government planning prose) and was rejected as support even though live. Replaced with two independent sources that DO name this exact segment and support 'operating': (1) an Oct-28-2024 procurement/tender-award notice on the operator's own portal (gigeps.com) for '田东-德保-靖西...安全设施竣工验收项目' -- 竣工验收 (completion/final acceptance) is a late regulatory sign-off consistent with the line already in service; (2) an independent Feb-11-2025 finance.sina.com.cn company report (广投管网公司, the abbreviated form of the operator) stating '成功取得田东-德保-靖西支线等3个项目管道开口，实现田东-德保-靖西支线建设完工并置换进气' (obtained pipeline tie-in approval and achieved construction completion + gas injection/线路置换进气 on this exact branch), reporting record 2024 full-year gas throughput of 14.1亿立方米 for the operator's network. Two independent, differently-hosted sources (a government-linked procurement platform and a major financial news portal), both dated Oct2024/Feb2025, corroborate 'operating' with no contradicting evidence found.

Both sources directly confirm Fuel=Gas for this exact pipeline. (1) gigeps.com tender title names the operator as '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' (Guangxi Guangtou NATURAL GAS Pipeline Network Co Ltd) doing safety-facility acceptance on the 田东-德保-靖西 line. (2) sina.com.cn article uses '天然气'/输气量 (natural-gas transmission volume) repeatedly describing the same operator's network, including this branch by name.

The origin fgw.gxzf.gov.cn URL geo-blocks (ConnectTimeout, per known-blocked-host list); used a web.archive.org snapshot of the same page instead (passes url_verifier). It is the Guangxi DRC's own project-approval decision 桂发改能源〔2018〕334号, '广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于广西天然气支线管网项目田东-德保-靖西天然气支线管道工程项目核准的批复', text-dated and signed '2018年3月28日', published 2018-03-30, which directly matches ProposalYear=2018 (approval/核准 = the proposal-stage decision in this schema). Single-source (the only primary approval document located; no independent second source found), but highly authoritative -- tier medium.

Searched extensively in Chinese for a source specifically supporting a Feb-2023 physical construction start: '田东-德保-靖西 开工建设 2023', '... 开工 2023年2月', '... EPC 施工总承包 中标', '百色市 重大项目 集中开工 2023年2月', and checked the 2023-02-16 bjx.com.cn 'Guangxi 2023 coordinated major projects list' article (paywalled/truncated on fetch, no readable project-level detail). Found only: (a) the 2018 DRC approval doc, which grants the construction PERMIT in March 2018 (a different, much earlier date than the recorded ConstructionYear=2023) and separately warns the permit lapses if construction doesn't start within 2 years (extendable once, max 1 more year) -- consistent with, but not proof of, an eventual ~2023 physical start; (b) the dead current-Status ref (mguangfu.bjx.com.cn, an April-2025 Baise government report) and a Dec-2023 shpgx.com company article, both of which describe the pipeline as already completed/nearly-complete by late 2023-2025, i.e. after any 2023 construction start, not the start itself. No page found stating a Feb-2023 (or any 2023) groundbreaking date for this specific segment. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than citing the 2018 permit date for a different (ConstructionYear) field, per the no-fabrication / don't-cite-a-different-value rule.

Same 2018 Guangxi DRC approval doc (wayback snapshot; origin geo-blocked). States '本工程设计输量为4.5亿立方米/年' (design throughput 0.45 billion m3/year) -- exact match to recorded Capacity=0.45 bcm/y. Single primary source; tier medium.

Same 2018 Guangxi DRC approval doc. States '本工程管道全长120km,位于田东县境内39km、德保县境内74km、靖西市境内7km' (total length 120km: 39km in Tiandong, 74km in Debao, 7km in Jingxi) -- exact match to recorded LengthKnown=120.00km. Single primary source; tier medium.
Same 2018 Guangxi DRC approval doc. States '管径为D355.6mm' -- exact match to recorded Diameter=355.60mm. Single primary source; tier medium.

Same 2018 Guangxi DRC approval doc. States '项目建设地点位于田东县、德保县和靖西市境内。管道起于田东县东达小学东侧的田东支线田东分输站,经过德保县,终于靖西市凌爱村东的靖西分输站' (project sited in Tiandong/Debao/Jingxi counties; pipeline starts at the Tiandong branch's Tiandong distribution station east of Dongda Primary School in Tiandong County, passes through Debao County, ends at the Jingxi distribution station east of Ling'ai Village in Jingxi City) -- exact match to recorded StartLocation ('Tiandong Branch Tiandong Distribution Station, Dongda Primary School, Tiandong County') and EndLocation ('Jingxi Distribution Station, Ling'ai Village, Jingxi City'), and confirms StartPrefecture/District=EndPrefecture/District=Baise, StartState/Province=EndState/Province=Guangxi (all three counties are under Baise prefecture-level city). Single primary source; tier medium.
Same 2018 Guangxi DRC approval doc. States '项目总投资为42149.35万元' (total project investment 421,493,500 RMB) -- exact match to recorded SegmentCost=421,493,500 RMB. Single primary source; tier medium.

(1) gigeps.com procurement notice names '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' verbatim as the entity running the 田东-德保-靖西 completion-acceptance project -- exact string match to QCCOwner(业主单位). (2) sina.com.cn independently corroborates the same entity, under its common abbreviated form '广投管网公司', operating this exact branch line (construction completion + gas injection on 田东-德保-靖西). Two independent, differently-hosted sources naming the same operator for the same named segment -- tier high.

Same two sources as Operator: 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 / 广投管网公司 (= Owner1 'Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd') is confirmed as the builder/operator of this exact pipeline by both. Neither source states an explicit ownership percentage, so Owner1%=100% is not independently re-derived (it follows from no other owner being named anywhere) -- tier medium to reflect that the percentage itself is inferred, though the identity of the 100% owner/operator is corroborated by two independent sources.
